checks.name: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) Compatibility
checks.details: HPA v2 manifests defined targeting CPU utilization (70%) and Custom Metrics (queue_depth)

checks.name: Resource Requests & Limits Explicitly Defined
checks.details: Worker pods define requests (CPU: 500m, RAM: 512Mi) and limits (CPU: 2000m, RAM: 2Gi)

checks.name: Readiness & Liveness Probes Validated
checks.details: HTTP readiness probe (/health) and liveness probe (/liveness) configured with proper initial delay

checks.name: Pod Disruption Budget (PDB) Configured
checks.details: PDB ensures minAvailable: 2 during rolling upgrades and node draining
